_: Content of the sketchbook: one entry per face of the book (cover, pages 2-17, back). Read by src/worlds/procreate/data.ts (captions, index, alt text) and by art-src/sketchbook/pages.mjs (the handwriting printed on each page), so the words in the pictures and the words on the screen are the same. Nothing here is a claim: no dates, no briefs, no clients, no names. The drawings are Pau's own Procreate pieces (statement of 2026-10-30).

pages.alt: The closed sketchbook: a scuffed black cloth cover with red tape along the spine, a taped-on paper label that reads SKETCHBOOK, procreate, for fun, not for work, a round sticker, a coffee ring and a few white pen doodles.
Page 2: the owner's label. This sketchbook belongs to Pau. If found, please return it. Reward: a coffee. A coffee ring and a thumbprint mark the paper.
Page 3: a hand-written list of what is inside, twelve drawings with their page numbers and a tick box each, and a note in red: made in Procreate, printed, glued in, no brief and no client.

pages.title: Hills & a tiny house
pages.line: blue hills, a red roof, a path that wanders off.
pages.alt: Page 4: a printed illustration taped into the book. Layers of blue hills fade into a pale sky with grainy clouds, green slopes in front, a tiny white house with a red roof and a winding cream path, all inside a tall pill shape. Handwritten title: Hills and a tiny house; a red arrow points at the house.

pages.title: Houses, stacked
pages.line: only squares and triangles. no curves allowed.
pages.alt: Page 5: a tall printed illustration of flat, geometric houses piled on top of each other in purple, orange, yellow, pink, teal and mint, each with a dark roof and square windows, on a grey-green sky. Handwritten title: Houses, stacked.

pages.title: Hillside town
pages.line: a whole town piled up a hill, every wall its own colour.
pages.alt: Page 6: a square printed illustration of a hillside town made of hundreds of flat-coloured blocks in orange, yellow, mint, lilac, red and cream with tiny windows, under a deep blue sky. Handwritten title: Hillside town, with a note and an arrow.

pages.title: Quick face
pages.line: round glasses, curly hair, big smile. one line, no fuss.
pages.alt: Page 7: a black ink line drawing straight on the paper: a smiling man's face with curly hair, round glasses, a moustache and a small beard, with faint pencil guide lines. Handwritten title: Quick face, and a note about the glasses.

pages.title: Five faces in circles
pages.line: five little people: beanie, shades, hoodie, beard.
pages.alt: Page 8: a black print glued in with five round portraits in cream line art on black: a man in a striped beanie, a bearded man in sunglasses, a moustached man in round shades, a man in a hoodie and a frowning bearded man. Handwritten labels with arrows name each one.

pages.title: Yellow cap
pages.line: cap, big glasses, wavy hair. the whole page is yellow.
pages.alt: Page 9: a square printed illustration of a bearded man in a cap and thick square glasses with wavy hair and a dark shirt, drawn in black outline on a yellow background. Handwritten title: Yellow cap.

pages.title: Four colours only
pages.line: a bearded guy in a cap, four warm tones. no more.
pages.alt: Page 10: a flat-colour portrait of a bearded man in a cap looking up, made of four warm tones, stuck on the page like a sticker, with four colour swatches beside it and a yellow note: too orange? no. keep it.

pages.title: Same four colours
pages.line: another face, the same four colours.
pages.alt: Page 11: a second flat-colour portrait in the same four warm tones, of a young man with a tall quiff and an earring, stuck on the page like a sticker, with the four colour swatches ticked off.

pages.title: Very serious man
pages.line: marker-ish. a very serious face on a very orange wall.
pages.alt: Page 12: a printed drawing of an older man with a furrowed brow and big ears in thick black marker lines and hatching, yellow skin, a green shirt, on a bright orange background. Handwritten title: Very serious man, and a strip of marker colour tests.

pages.title: An eye made of lines
pages.line: an eye, an ear, a curl of hair. only little lines.
pages.alt: Page 13: a torn clipping of a close-up black and white drawing built only from fine hatched lines: a curled lock of hair, an ear and an eye with a dark pupil. Handwritten title: An eye made of lines, and a small hatching test in pencil.

pages.title: Hatching, a body
pages.line: same game, but a body: ribs, belly, folds of cloth.
pages.alt: Page 14: a small torn clipping of a hatched and cross-hatched black and white drawing of a torso with ribs, belly and a fold of cloth. Handwritten title: Hatching, a body.

pages.title: Citrus & leaves
pages.line: two fruits, a wedge and a few leaves. all tiny lines.
pages.alt: Page 15: a black ink drawing straight on the paper of two citrus fruits on a leafy branch with a loose wedge in front, shaded with tiny lines. Handwritten title: Citrus and leaves.
Page 16: colour tests: scribbled swatches in the colours of the drawings, pen tests, and a short list headed to draw next: more hills, more lines, a hand (scary).
Page 17: the last page. A big handwritten that's all, for now, a few small doodles, an ink blot and a note that says thanks for flipping through.
The back cover: scuffed black cloth with a white sticker that says NOT FOR SALE in red marker, and in pencil, it's a sketchbook.
